title: POST /api/chat — request body
description: One user message to the agent. The conversation is identified by session_id; the agent keeps its own memory of it, so the caller sends only the new message, never the history.

session_id.description: identifies the conversation; a follow-up (including a 'yes' to a held action) must use the same value

language.description: optional hint: the caller's language setting (for example Home Assistant's Assist language). A tie-breaker only: the agent answers in the language the user wrote in

source.description: optional: where the message came from; shown in the History tab. Defaults to the web chat
